characters.name: Hanen
characters.description: A regal rooster with vibrant red feather plumage and a golden comb. Tall and robust with striking eyes. Known for his pompous and assertive demeanor in discussions, often strutting around in the company of his counterparts, Gjøgen and Aarhanen.

characters.name: Gjøgen
characters.description: A colorful cuckoo with shimmering iridescent feathers. Slightly smaller than Hanen, with a curious glint in his eyes. Gjøgen is crafty and tends to swiftly enter into debates, especially in the company of Hanen and Aarhanen over who deserves the cow.

characters.name: Aarhanen
characters.description: A dignified rooster with a slightly more subdued color palette than Hanen, yet equally charismatic. Known for his logical approach and penchant for fairness, often playing the voice of reason in disagreements over the cow.

characters.name: Lillekort
characters.description: A brave and clever young boy with a slender build and shaggy brown hair. Often seen wearing mismatched clothing due to his humble beginnings. Known for wielding a mighty sword and navigating a magical ship that can traverse land and sea. His adventures bring him face to face with trolls and treasures, highlighting his courage and resourcefulness.

characters.name: Kong Lavring
characters.description: The identical twin brother of Lillekort, similar in appearance with the same youthful features and build. Like his brother, he possesses keen intellect and courage but is marked by his prominent role in the narrative's resolution. He is eventually united with one of the princesses, sharing the kingdom's wealth.

characters.name: Kongsdatteren
characters.description: The king's daughter, possessing exquisite beauty with flowing hair and gentle eyes. Her attire transforms from simple to regal throughout the story, reflecting her royal status. Known for her gentleness, wit, and the deep gratitude she shows towards Lillekort for saving her from the trolls.

characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.description: A deceitful knight with a tall, muscular build and fiery red hair. Often dressed in striking armor, exuding a false sense of bravado. Known for his cowardice and attempts to take credit for others' heroic deeds, specifically those of Lillekort.
